content_sections.heading: Goa Dental College & Hospital Staff Nurse Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the Goa Dental College & Hospital Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download Goa Dental College & Hospital Staff Nurse Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Staff Nurse: Certificate in Nursing from a recognized Institution AND Certificate in Midwifery/Special training for Male Nurses for 6 months duration OR B.Sc. Nursing, Registration Certificate as Registered Nurse or Registered Midwife from State Council, Knowledge of Konkani

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Staff Nurse: Maximum Age: 45 years Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the prescribed age criteria. Calculate your exact age using our Age Calculator before submitting your application to confirm your eligibility.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Goa Dental College & Hospital Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Goa Dental College & Hospital for filling up vacant posts on a contract basis through a walk-in interview process.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The post advertised is Staff Nurse on a maternity leave vacancy basis for eligible and qualified healthcare professionals.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Staff Nurse post in Goa Dental College & Hospital.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Staff Nurse post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Staff Nurse position will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 47,500/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the date of the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Goa Dental College & Hospital Staff Nurse recruitment is scheduled to take place on 08 October 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What are the essential educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Certificate in Nursing/Midwifery or B.Sc. Nursing along with a valid Registration Certificate and knowledge of Konkani.

faq.question: Q7. What is the maximum age limit to apply?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants applying for the Staff Nurse position is set at 45 years.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application and selection is strictly via Walk-in Interview where candidates must report directly to the venue.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location for selected candidates?
faq.answer: The job location for the selected candidate will be at Cujira, Santa Cruz, Tiswadi in the state of Goa.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required at the time of the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring an application form, recent photograph, original and self-attested copies of educational certificates, birth certificate, and residence proof.
